hero.badge: Ni ubuntu · Ni ibanga · Icyongereza n'Ikinyarwanda
hero.subtitle: Rinda ni isuzuma rigufi kandi ry'ibanga ry'imibereho itandatu ya buri munsi, rigenewe urubyiruko mu Rwanda. Ubona igisubizo gisobanutse kuri buri gice, n'aho wabona ubufasha nyabwo.

phone.step: Iminota hafi 20 y'inyongera y'imyitozo mu minsi 3

float.private: Ibitswe mu ibanga kuri telefoni yawe

features.title: Ibyo ukeneye byose kugira ngo wumve ubuzima bwawe
features.subtitle: Nta magambo akomeye, nta gucira urubanza. Ibisubizo byawe gusa, impamvu bifite akamaro, n’ikintu kimwe wakora gikurikira.

checkup.title: Isuzuma mu minota hafi icumi
checkup.body: Itabi, inzoga, imyitozo, ibiryo, ingano y'umubiri n'umuvuduko w'amaraso. Simbuka icyo udashaka gusubiza.

results.title: Ibisubizo bisobanutse
results.body: Buri gice cyerekana ijambo n'ikimenyetso, si ibara gusa, hamwe n'impamvu mu magambo yoroshye.

steps.title: Intambwe nto zikurikira
steps.body: Rinda ihitamo ibice bike byo kwitaho mbere kandi igatanga impinduka imwe nto ishoboka.

mood.title: Imitekerereze n'umunaniro, mu ibanga
mood.body: Isuzuma ritari itegeko ry'uko wiyumvise, ryerekanwa ukwaryo kandi ntirivangwa n'ibindi bisubizo.

guide.title: Baza Rinda
guide.body: Kanda ku kibazo maze ibisubizo byawe bisobanurwe mu magambo y'ubucuti, avuye mu mabwiriza yemejwe.

offline.title: Ikora nta interineti
offline.body: Shyira Rinda kuri telefoni yawe. Amasuzuma abarirwa kuri telefoni kandi akoherezwa iyo interineti igarutse.

s1.title: Fungura konti y’ubuntu
s1.body: Koresha imeri cyangwa nimero ya telefoni, cyangwa winjire na Google. Hitamo Icyongereza cyangwa Ikinyarwanda.

s2.title: Subiza isuzuma rigufi
s2.body: Ibibazo byoroshye n'ibipimo bike. Buri kibazo gishobora gusimbukwa.

s3.title: Soma ibisubizo byawe
s3.body: Reba buri gice gisobanuwe, intambwe yawe nto ikurikira, n'aho wabona ubufasha ubukeneye.

rwanda.title: Imibereho myiza itangira mbere y’uko ibibazo biza
rwanda.body: Indwara nyinshi z'umutima n'iz'imibereho zikura bucece mu myaka yacu ya makumyabiri na mirongo itatu. Rinda igufasha kubimenya kare, mu rurimi rwawe, kandi ikakwereka serivisi nyazo mu Rwanda.

privacy.title: Ibisubizo byawe ni ibyawe
privacy.p1: Nta matangazo, nta bakurikirana, nta kugurisha amakuru.
privacy.p2: Ibyo ubika kuri telefoni yawe biba bihishwe (encrypted).
privacy.p3: Uhitamo ibyo usangiza, kandi ushobora kubihindura igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.
privacy.p4: Saba ko amakuru yawe asibwa, azaba yavuyeho mu masaha 72.
privacy.p5: "Shaka ubufasha ubu" buri gihe kiri hafi, ukanda rimwe gusa.

about.title: Yakorewe wowe, n'urubyiruko rwose mu Rwanda
about.body: Rinda ni iy'urubyiruko rushaka kumva ubuzima bwarwo nta kujya kwa muganga, nta fishi ndende kandi nta gucirwa urubanza. Usubiza ibibazo bike byoroshye, ukareba aho uhagaze muri buri gice, kandi ukabona intambwe imwe nto ushobora gutera koko. Ibisubizo byawe bihora ari ibyawe, kandi ubufasha buri hafi, ukanda rimwe gusa.
about.where: Ahantu hose mu Rwanda, ndetse nta interineti

faq.title: Ibibazo bikunze kubazwa
faq.q1: Ese Rinda ni isuzuma rya muganga?
faq.a1: Oya. Rinda ni iyo kwiga. Igufasha kumva imibereho ya buri munsi kandi ikakubwira igihe ari byiza kubonana n'umukozi w'ubuzima.
faq.a2: Yego. Rinda ni ubuntu, nta matangazo.
faq.q3: Ni nde ushobora kubona ibisubizo byanjye?
faq.a3: Ni wowe wenyine ubona ibisubizo byawe. Abakozi b'ubushakashatsi babona imibare n'amazina ahishwe, ntibabona ibisubizo byawe.
faq.a4: Yego. Nyuma yo kuyifungura bwa mbere ushobora kuyishyira kuri telefoni. Amasuzuma akozwe nta interineti abarirwa kuri telefoni yawe akoherezwa nyuma.
faq.a5: Kanda "Shaka ubufasha ubu" igihe icyo ari cyo cyose urebe imirongo n'aho wahamagara ako kanya. Rinda si serivisi y'ubutabazi bwihuse.
faq.a6: Icyongereza n'Ikinyarwanda. Ushobora guhindura igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.

contact.title: Tuvugane
contact.body: Ufite ibibazo kuri Rinda cyangwa ku bushakashatsi? Twishimiye kukumva.

cta.title: Witeguye isuzuma ryawe rya mbere?
cta.body: Bifata iminota hafi icumi, ni ubuntu, kandi ushobora guhagarara igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.

s1.title: Ubuzima bwawe, busobanuwe mu magambo yoroshye.
s1.body: Imibereho itandatu ya buri munsi, igisubizo kimwe gisobanutse kuri buri imwe.

s2.title: Intambwe nto ushobora gukomeza.
s2.body: Rinda igutekerereza impinduka imwe ishoboka icyarimwe.

s3.title: Ni ibanga, ni ubuntu kandi ni mu rurimi rwawe.
s3.body: Icyongereza cyangwa Ikinyarwanda, kuri telefoni yawe, ndetse nta interineti.
